verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say it automatically produces 'suggested AI action items' for every meeting. Its action items carry assignees and due dates, and they can be listed, filtered by assignee, and marked complete, so they are collected and trackable. However, the docs never say the AI-extracted items are automatically assigned to owners; 'suggested' implies a user must review them. missing for 10: explicit documentation that extracted action items are auto-assigned to owners without manual review, a description of the in-app central action-item tracker, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
action items with assignees and due dates
assigned_to_me: Only action items assigned to the authenticated user
